Your browser asks before sharing location. MED+250 prioritises and assigns up to 10 verified pharmacies closest to the request location, with a verified WhatsApp fallback when approved premises coordinates are unavailable. Assigned pharmacies initially receive only an approximate distance—or a national-service label—and the product information and available catalogue images needed to decide whether they can fulfil it.

MED+250 publishes central product information and indicative From RWF prices. It helps customers identify pharmacies that confirm availability for a private request. Only pharmacies are sellers and dispensing parties. MED+250 does not publish pharmacy-specific stock or price lists.

MED+250 uses the WhatsApp Cloud API to deliver one-time verification codes, assigned request alerts to pharmacies, and response alerts to customers. Delivery status is recorded for reliability. Central catalogue prices are indicative only, and MED+250 does not publish pharmacy-specific prices or stock. Opening a pharmacy chat or the phone's MoMo menu leaves MED+250 and is governed by the relevant service and your mobile operator. MED+250 does not process or hold the payment.
